mapper.sql: o.id, o.order_no, o.product_id, p.title AS product_title, (SELECT pi.image_url FROM product_image pi WHERE pi.product_id = o.product_id ORDER BY pi.is_cover DESC, pi.id ASC LIMIT 1) AS product_image, o.buyer_id, bu.username AS buyer_name, o.seller_id, su.username AS seller_name, o.address_id, a.receiver_name, a.receiver_phone, CONCAT_WS(' ', a.province, a.city, a.district, a.detail_address) AS full_address, o.quantity, o.unit_price, o.total_amount, o.shipping_fee, o.pay_amount, o.pay_method, o.pay_time, o.order_status, o.ship_time, o.receive_time, o.cancel_time, o.cancel_reason, o.buyer_remark, o.create_time, o.update_time
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN base_user bu ON o.buyer_id = bu.id LEFT JOIN base_user su ON o.seller_id = su.id LEFT JOIN address a ON o.address_id = a.id WHERE o.id = #{id}
SELECT CAST(order_status AS SIGNED) AS `status`, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM `order` o WHERE o.buyer_id = #{buyerId} GROUP BY o.order_status
SELECT CAST(order_status AS SIGNED) AS `status`, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM `order` o WHERE o.seller_id = #{sellerId} GROUP BY o.order_status
